statements.impact_statement: atomic-polyfill 1.0.3 is unmaintained. The crate compiles to no-ops on x86_64 / aarch64 (our supported targets). It is reached transitively via garde -> phonenumber -> postcard 1.x -> heapless 0.7. No exploitation path exists in our targets.
